reason: The cited evidence only shows that WTaMoNbV can be printed as a bulk alloy via LPBF with similar properties to arc-melted material. It provides no support for its use as a coating, its adhesion to a Ti-Ni substrate, or its strengthening and oxidation resistance at high temperature.
premises: WTaMoNbV can be deposited as a coating via LPBF
WTaMoNbV coating will bond to a Ti-Ni HEA substrate
WTaMoNbV coating provides strengthening at elevated temperature
